warnings: *** THE R PIPE SUFFIX IS NOT IN SN-01's LEGEND. *** Two overflow pipes on this plan are labelled ท่อน้ำล้น ø2" R and ø1 1/2" R, but SN-01's สัญลักษณ์ defines only CW, V, S and W as line codes. R is used here without being declared anywhere in the set. Recorded as printed with the Thai label ท่อน้ำล้น (overflow) carrying the meaning; no definition was invented for the letter.

THE ø1 1/2" OVERFLOW AGREES WITH A-05, which marks ท่อน้ำล้น P.V.C. ø1 1/2" at the same west wall of ห้องนอน 1 - an architectural sheet and a sanitary sheet independently giving the same pipe the same size.

ALL EIGHT ROOM LEVELS MATCH A-05 EXACTLY (+4.00 rooms, +3.95 bathrooms, +3.90 balcony). Together with SN-01's ground floor that makes the sanitary set fully consistent with the architectural set on levels - the only level dispute anywhere in this house remains A-08's ซักล้าง, resolved on that file.
PIPES RECORDED BY TYPE AND SIZE, NOT TRACED RUN BY RUN - same convention and same reason as SN-01.
GRID CHAIN MATCHES THE MASTER: 3.50 + 2.20 + 3.00 = 8.70 and the full 11.40 y chain.
This file covers the main plan only; the six bathroom pipe enlargements and the gutter detail are separate views on this sheet per §3.
